en.Eigene Symbole für die Tankstellen-Liste: Own symbols for the station list: a symbol replaces the coloured circle with two letters in front of a station's name in the tile.
en.So geht's: 1. Bild in Symcon als Medieno: How to: 1. Create the image in Symcon as a media object (ideally square, up to 512 KB). 2. Click “Add” below. 3. Under “Station”, enter the name shown in bold above the address in the tile. 4. Under “Symbol”, select the image.
